geo_basis: country as stated by Tek Notícias (Portuguese company, plans to consolidate operations in Portugal); city not stated
date_note: The page gives no earlier day for the announcement than its publication day, 24 November.
title: Magic Beans to invest more than one million euros in new cybersecurity brand Magic Shield with Cloudflare partnership
summary: Tek Notícias reports that Magic Beans plans to invest "mais de um milhão de euros" in a new cybersecurity brand, Magic Shield, built on a partnership with Cloudflare. According to company executives quoted by the outlet, the brand targets cloud security and AI security, and the company aims for "2,5 milhões de euros" in revenue next year.
plain: Portuguese firm Magic Beans says it will invest "mais de um milhão de euros" in a new cybersecurity brand, Magic Shield, partnered with Cloudflare, focused on cloud and AI security.
exec: A Portuguese IT firm is entering cybersecurity with a Cloudflare-based brand, investing "mais de um milhão de euros", according to Tek Notícias.

evidence.quote: mais de um milhão de euros

validation.note: Only Tek Notícias (24 Nov) read; it relays statements by Magic Beans executives. No company release read.

review.note: Compared date, investment and revenue quotes, Cloudflare partnership and focus with Tek Noticias
